Agent Name: Bioinformatics_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Bioinformatics_Expert failed to identify the correct, stable reference genome assembly relevant to May 2020. While the search results indicated that CanFam3.1 was the standard reference used in studies published around that time (e.g., the May 2020 Nature article), the expert incorrectly prioritized newer, breed-specific assemblies (like UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0/canFam4) and provided links to articles published in 2023 and 2024. This resulted in providing links that were not accessible or relevant to the specific "May 2020" constraint, whereas the correct answer requires the link to the CanFam3.1 distribution files.
